title: A turn-on fluorescent probe containing a β-ketoester moiety for the selective detection of intracellular hydrazine
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,428-434
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06525E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Akira Takagi, Ippei Takashima, Kensuke Okuda
A selective and quantitative OFF–ON fluorescent hydrazine probe was developed based on a coumarin platform. Elaboration of the β-keto moiety improved the responsiveness of the probe for sensing hydrazine in living cells.
